ref.note: Line amount from the adjustment decree (chapter II); AB detail from the initial budget tables. The RTBF dotation is tied to the RTBF management contract 2023-2027 (doc. 184 N°1, annex on the CCA: 'Dotation de la Fédération Wallonie-Bruxelles dans le cadre du contrat de gestion de la RTBF'), so it is not freely adjustable year to year. The line also covers justice houses (maisons de justice), youth and adult education, health promotion and infrastructure. ONE also funds child health consultations; the phrase names only childcare. one.be was reachable but not needed. The items used are standing dotations and subsidies, not one-off provisions, so using the initial tables to describe the adjusted chapter is sound. corrected: flag 1: all AB labels confirmed in doc. 184 N°1 (PDF pp. 117, 123, 134, 142, 150) and are standing items. Youth-care phrase reworded to the funded services (accueil familial = foster care) and FR shortened; 'culture' dropped from the last phrase (too broad; libraries and local sports centres are the named items) to bring FR from 13 to 9 words
